title: Roar Bunker
description: A raw, bass-led speed-garage burner: a roaring detuned reese-organ sub rolls under a swung 4x4 606 kick, choked hats skip and pump, and a chopped diva vocal hook flickers over sidechained pads. It hits its peak early then deconstructs into a dark, dry bunker groove.
code:
setcpm(135/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.92).shape(0.3),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(6000),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").add(note("<0 0.12>")).lpf(320).gain(0.7)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.95).shape(0.35),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.7).room(0.15),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.55).hpf(5500),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").add(note("0,0.14")).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(350, 1100)).resonance(8).shape(0.35).gain(0.72),
    s("swpad").n(1).note("<c3 eb3>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.28, 0.7)).lpf(2200).room(0.25)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.98).shape(0.4),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.75).room(0.18),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(7000),
    s("oh(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.4).hpf(4000),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").add(note("0,0.16,12")).ply("<1 1 2 1>").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(500, 1600)).resonance(10).shape(0.4).gain(0.7),
    s("numbers").n("<0 1 2 3>").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5>").gain(0.6).hpf(400).room(0.2).every(4, x => x.rev()),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [bb3,eb4,g4]>").s("piano").struct("~ x ~ x x ~").gain(0.5).room(0.25)
  ).swingBy(0.15, 8)],
  [16, stack(
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).room(0.3),
    note("<[c2,eb2,g2,bb2] [ab1,c2,eb2,g2] [f1,ab1,c2,eb2] [g1,bb1,d2,f2]>").s("square").add(note("0,0.12")).lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 900)).resonance(7).gain(0.62),
    s("swpad").n(2).note("<c3 ab2 f2 g2>").slow(2).gain(saw.slow(4).range(0.3, 0.78)).lpf(1800).room(0.35).vowel("<a o e>"),
    s("numbers").n("<4 5>").chop(8).slice(8, "7 5 3 1 6 4 2 0").speed("<0.5 1>").gain(0.55).hpf(500).room(0.3)
  ).swingBy(0.15, 8)],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.0).shape(0.45),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.78).room(0.18),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.52).hpf(7500).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("oh(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.42).hpf(4200),
    s("~ lt ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 4>")),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("triangle").add(note("0,0.18,12,7")).ply("<1 2 1 4>").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(600, 2200)).resonance(12).shape(0.5).crush(8).gain(0.68),
    s("numbers").n("<0 1 2 3 4 5>").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5 2>").gain(0.6).hpf(450).room(0.2).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4,bb4] [g3,bb3,d4,f4]>").s("piano").struct("~ x ~ x x ~ x ~").gain(0.5).room(0.22)
  ).swingBy(0.15, 8)],
  [14, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.85).shape(0.3),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR606").cut(1).gain(0.45).hpf(6500),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").add(note("0,0.12")).lpf(sine.slow(8).range(280, 700)).gain(0.65),
    s("swpad").n(0).note("<c3 eb3>").slow(4).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.25, 0.6)).lpf(1400).room(0.3)
  ).swingBy(0.16, 8)]
)
